'''Graveyard Road''' was a pathway crossing the northern side of the [[Glacial Fissure]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Linking [[Outpost Senth]] in the west with [[Outpost Zerek]] at the edge of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] to the east, the road ran along the rim of part of the fissure itself and separated the [[Northern Whitelands]] from the [[Southern Whitelands]].
